notes.title: A NextFest Retrospective and The Future of MINDFLUX
notes.content:
NextFest 2024 is dead and gone... 
But we're not.

Far from it, actually. The energy on the Lost Gate team is electric. We've had this demo/build prepared for a while now, but felt that it was necessary to receive public feedback before we could really proceed with confidence. Throughout NextFest, hundreds of you played and submitted your thoughts, hopes, and concerns regarding MINDFLUX and it's future...

So what's next?

Big changes, that's what.

New Horrifying Ideas

The tone of MINDFLUX has always been spooky. This world teeters on the precipice of utter madness as cataclysmic events loom at every corner of the island. Beyond this, Ambrose's past, present, and future is also shrouded in an aura of fear. Our first step is to lean further into this.

For those who have seen the animated cinematic SKINWALKER, you've probably noticed that things aren't going very well for the denizens of this world OR Ambrose. I wonder if some new mechanics are going to be introduced based on what we've seen in the cinematic... hmm...
[previewyoutube=qanynqRxu9c;full]here[/previewyoutube]
More details to come on this, but for now, know that we are working to make MINDFLUX a more psychologically interesting experience.

Player Flow and Mechanical Adjustments

While the major pieces of our core game play loop are performing well in terms of expected behavior and stability, we feel the overall player experience needs adjustment. Based on observations from numerous play tests and community streams, we've laid out some goals we want to achieve in the second public version of our core game play loop.
[olist]
Reconstruct the Tutorial section, focusing specifically on creating organic exposure to new game concepts.
Reduce the amount of tutorial pop up windows.
Retool fundamental design structures within current conversations.
Overhaul object investigations to be more engaging.
Incorporate new use-cases and adjust original use cases for hardware modifications.
Create new feedback methods that guide the player into critical thinking regarding dialogue choices.
[/olist]
We're hoping this next iteration creates a stronger environment for critical thinking, where the player's observations and notions regarding individuals they encounter will dramatically change the way they choose to engage with them, and ultimately how everything pans out.

Bug Fixes and Gameplay Amplifications

We're also looking to continuously polish current elements:
[olist]
Player controller and camera refinement.
Collision polish.
Bug fixing reported issues discovered during NextFest.
[/olist]
Art/Sound/Music Amplification

In addition to design alterations, we're also looking to amplify the art efficacy of existing and future areas. This is to further develop the world's character, creating richer environmental storytelling and assisting the player in their investigations. Our environmental art team will be doing continuous location analysis, pushing ideas further and judging whether a location fulfills all narrative and artistic requirements.

Conclusion

With the feedback from NextFest and the creation of our new community (hello by the way!), we're looking to make MINDFLUX a more spooky, engaging experience where your understanding of each character, the world, and the situation at hand will dramatically shift where your investigation ends up. 

If you are interested in learning more about MINDFLUX or would like to assist us in developing the game, please join our Discord linked below. Our developers respond to questions and feedback whenever they can. In addition, if you are interested in assisting us financially, we are creating a Patreon. Benefits, such as first access to new builds, private channels to communicate with developers, and being featured as a supporter in the credits are just some of the rewards you can receive. While our Patreon is not currently live, we will announce its opening on our discord and all other social media platforms.

Thanks again, and welcome to the RUSTED FUTURE. We're just getting started.

-Chan [Creative Director]

notes.title: Changes & Bug Fixes: Oct 24 2024
notes.content:
Changes

 Added some dialogue to the Arms Dealer that triggers if you bring him Saarpen's Old Mod.
 Added some dialogue to the final encounter with Hobbes the Clinic. You should now be able to wrap up the demo without breaking your promise to Bys.



Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where the "Investigate" button in the inventory would still be visible and clickable if you select an item that can't be investigated. This would cause an error when clicked. The button should now be correctly hidden when you select an item that can't be investigated.

 Made some changes to the first Hobbes encounter. She should no longer force the dialogue to end early or make you re-start the encounter from the beginning.

notes.title: MINDFLUX: Dead Man Walking is Entering Public Beta Testing
notes.content:
MINDFLUX: Dead Man Walking (MDMW) has entered its beta testing phase!

We over here at Lost Gate have been dreaming of including players outside of our team for testing. It’s a milestone we are thrilled to have reached, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts and have you help us create a far more polished, robust experience!

For those who don’t know, MDMW is a roleplaying game set in the dystopian Rusted Future, a technological dark age of madness, subterfuge, and unbridled discovery. You play as an investigator who hunts the most dangerous category of killer. You must use your mechanical augmentation to uncover suspects' hidden truths and accomplish tasks commissioned by your mysterious employer.

Our primary goal with this playtest is to confirm that our custom RPG system, called Cascade, is as solid as it can be. We have ambitious plans for additional features we can’t wait to develop, but step one is making sure our base gameplay loop is stable. That’s where you come in!

This product is our demo, a 30 minute to 1 hour experience that will expose you to the core concepts of the Cascade system. We want to hear the good, bad, and ugly of your experience. Every detail will help us forge a far more enjoyable experience.

Our desire is to elevate this system, reach a broader audience, and gain the insight/resources to take MINDFLUX to the next level. With your help, our driven team of passionate indie developers will make that happen.

Below is a detailed description written by our Technical Director Ian of the playtest parameters, our goals, and next steps for you as you assist us in this journey! From all of us at Lost Gate, thank you for taking your time to look at our game and for assisting us in making MDMW the best it can be!

-Chan, Creative Director of Lost Gate

What is the Beta?

This beta is a nearly complete version of our game’s demo, which will be released in October as part of Steam Next Fest. We are still working hard to add polish to the game’s controls and UI elements, fix bugs, and improve the overall player experience. Some of the animations might be a little awkward, some of the text might not be formatted correctly, and you may even get stuck or fall off the map. That being said, it’s all working well-enough that we are ready to get some early feedback.

What are our goals?

1. We want to make sure that our build works consistently from steam on a variety of hardware setups. Our team is small, and we can only really test on our own machines. This beta might help us identify problems that we might have otherwise missed with internal testing.

2. We want to test the clarity and pacing of the narrative and new player experience while there is still time to make adjustments. At this point we have gone through several iterations of the content present in the demo, and getting some outside perspective will be helpful. If players feel lost, get stuck, or don’t understand how to play the game, we will want to know.

3. We are also hoping to collect some more general feedback on the game and its content. Share what you liked about the demo, what you didn’t like, and things you would want to see in the future. 
Your experience and feedback are invaluable to Lost Gate Studios as we continue developing MINDFLUX: Dead Man Walking. 

How do I Participate?

Head to the Mindflux: Dead Man Walking page on the steam store. From there, look for the banner that says “Join the MINDFLUX: Dead Man Walking Playtest” and click the Request Access button. After the Beta Test starts, you’ll be notified through steam when you are able to download the game.

Alternatively, you can go to the Lost Gate Studios website https://www.lostgatestudios.com/ and sign up for the beta there. If you are selected, you’ll receive a key via email which you can redeem on Steam to gain access to the playtest version of the game.

The test will begin... NOW! 

The test officially ends Monday at 3pm EST but there may be more tests in the future.

The Feedback Process

You can find our feedback form here: https://forms.gle/JkxEHPDS736u82qw7

If you encounter anything that might be a bug, please report that here: https://forms.gle/v9H2R4dtUVuniWqa8


With all that said, what comes after the Beta?

With your feedback, we will actively update the project with fixes. Communication between our developers and our most active playtesters will be established through our community discord. A list of desired features will be compiled and adjusted through the lens of our playtesters' considerations.

On October 14th, the MDMW demo will be accessible publicly during the Steam Next Fest. We hope you engage with us by wish listing the demo, telling your friends about it, and getting your favorite content creators to check us out!

We will also be initiating a Patreon, the funding of which will go toward making MDMW the best game it can be. Information regarding patron-specific rewards will come in the future.

There are big plans for the MINDFLUX world and future additions that we can’t wait to tell you about. Until then, check out our steam page, play the demo, and tell people about us!

From all of us at Lost Gate, thank you! We look forward to seeing you in the Rusted Future.
